result.title: REPL workflow.requirements.generateDocument rejects format markdown and docType fr: OptionalEnum overload binds the first allowed value as the error path
result.summary: ReplYamlMessageValidator registers generateDocument with OptionalEnum(args, "format", errors, "markdown", "yaml", "wiki") and OptionalEnum(args, "docType", errors, "fr", "tr", ...). C# overload resolution picks OptionalEnum(args, key, errors, string path, params string[] values) over OptionalEnum(args, key, errors, params string[] values) because it has more declared parameters, so "markdown" and "fr" become the error path and are dropped from the allowed sets. Result: the documented call generateDocument format: markdown docType: fr fails schema_validation_failed ("markdown must be one of: yaml, wiki." / "fr must be one of: tr, test, matrix, all, functional, technical, testing, mapping."), while RequirementsWorkflow.ValidateFormat and the REST endpoint accept markdown. Markdown requirement projections (docs/Project/*.md) cannot be regenerated through the plugin route.
